Harper Nguyen: Repro report from support: onboarding sample caused duplicate order creation. Flow: short-lived token expired mid-POST, SDK refreshed, upstream returned 429, immediate retry created a second order.

Ethan Zhou: which language/version?

Harper Nguyen: our internal sample uses dotnet-sdk v0.3. The app sets `Idempotency-Key` but after middleware replay the header was absent.

Maya Singh: ok. We've fixed whitelist issues in other SDKs but this keeps recurring. Two directions: (A) ensure auth replay preserves user headers by default, (B) synthesize a short-lived replay token when Idempotency-Key missing, so retries still dedupe.

Ethan Zhou: I like (B) because it handles header-drop anywhere in the pipeline. Sketch: SDK attaches `X-Client-Replay: <uuid>` on mutating requests without Idempotency-Key and keeps a local hash store for replayWindowMs (default 20s). If a retry occurs, SDK reattaches same replay token so server can dedupe.

Harper Nguyen: server-side parity needed: accept X-Client-Replay and compare body hash+token. If server supports, return `X-Replay-Span: 20` to indicate dedupe window. Fallback: client local dedupe if server doesn't support header.

Maya Singh: also we should standardize 429 backoff. Proposal: full jitter per attempt (AWS style):

base=200ms
max=5000ms
backoff = min(max, base * 2^attempt)
sleep = rand(0, backoff)

Ethan Zhou: + config knobs: { strictRetries: boolean, replayWindowMs: number, preserveHeaders: string[] }. Default strictRetries=false. If strictRetries=true SDK refuses to retry non-idempotent methods without explicit Idempotency-Key. Useful for customers in payments.

Harper Nguyen: QA items: unit test for token refresh + 429 asserting single backend create; integration matrix across dotnet/java/node to validate replay token behavior and header preservation. Also load-test to ensure local replay cache doesn't grow unbounded.

Maya Singh: telemetry events: sdk.replay.token_created, sdk.replay.reused, sdk.replay.header_dropped, sdk.replay.strict_blocked. Add a small console warning in onboarding sample when strictRetries=true and user didn't set Idempotency-Key.

Ethan Zhou: one more edge: streaming resume paths (websocket/long-poll) may reuse auth replay code — audit and add parity tests. If affected open DEX-5122.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEX-5119: "dotnet-sdk: preserve headers + client replay token + standardized 429 backoff" https://redwood.atlassian/browse/DEX-5119 :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Ops alert created for accounts matching duplicate-create telemetry pattern.

Harper Nguyen: I'll draft a small RFC with API sketches and a PR that: preserve Idempotency-Key in auth replay, implement client replay token + local cache default 20s, add full-jitter backoff, and strictRetries flag. Will include tests and telemetry. Ping me for review.
